gaps.quote: So the rank of $\Theta_V - \Theta_U$ is the dimension of $V \cap U^\perp$

gaps.quote: when the form on all of $X$ is nondegenerate, $\dim U^\perp = \dim X - \dim U$
gaps.note: This dimension formula for the orthogonal complement is asserted without proof. The reader cannot check it from the page, which does not derive it from the definitions.

gaps.term: Complementarity of U-perp without a nondegeneracy hypothesis
gaps.quote: So $U^\perp$ is complementary to $U$, and the projection onto $U$ along $U^\perp$ is defined.
gaps.note: This conclusion needs the form on all of X to be nondegenerate, which is the hypothesis of the dimension formula. The page only says the form is a bilinear form on X and never assumes nondegeneracy, so the conclusion does not follow from what the page states.
